description: The agent must: (1) Discover and use the `node /opt/loci/scripts/loci.mjs` CLI with `--palace /workspace/data/lab_palace.json` on EVERY command to avoid touching the default palace path. (2) Run `$LOCI domains --add protocols` (or equivalent domains subcommand) to register the custom domain. (3) Run `$LOCI store <domain> '<content>' --tag <tag> --palace /workspace/data/lab_palace.json` at least 3 times across different domains including 'protocols'. (4) Run `$LOCI link <id1> <id2> --palace ...` to create a bidirectional connection between two memory IDs — the tool writes the link in both directions automatically. (5) Run `$LOCI prune --threshold 0.3 --palace ...` — the seeded stale memories (IDs aabbcc11, aabbcc22, aabbcc33) were last accessed 200 days ago, giving them weight ≈ e^(-0.05×200) ≈ 0.0000454, well below 0.3, so they are removed; the fresh memories (ddee1122, ddee3344) with weight ~1.0 are retained. (6) Run `$LOCI export --format md --palace ... > /workspace/output/palace_snapshot.md`. (7) Run `$LOCI status --palace ... > /workspace/output/palace_status.txt`. The key proprietary traps are: the `--palace` flag required on every command, the `--threshold` parameter for prune, the `--format md` export flag, and the `domains` subcommand for adding custom categories.
